card.title: The Champion's Debt
card.summary: Three years ago a back-alley bout left Neon Champion owing a favour. Tonight the collector brings an old photograph — and the ledger's last page says that match was written before the bell.
card.quote: The rule on this street is simple: debts get paid.

hero-volt-01.title: Segment 1 · The Debt
hero-volt-01.summary: A rainy night, half the cage lights dead. The match that never finished three years ago is about to be settled.

h1-intro.speaker: Narration
h1-intro.text: It rained all night. Only half the lights in the cage were on, and half the stands were empty — everyone had heard who was coming.

h1-hero.speaker: Neon Champion
h1-hero.text: The rule on this street is simple: debts get paid. I know the one who's coming tonight.

h1-choice.prompt: She stands at the edge of the cage. She doesn't step in.

h1-talk.speaker: Pipa Girl
h1-talk.text: She isn't here for money. Three years ago the man you let walk out saved a whole street. She came to tell you he's still alive.

h1-glove.speaker: Neon Champion
h1-glove.text: Once the gloves are on, words stop working. But some debts were always meant to be settled with fists.

h1-battle.title: Settling the Debt
h1-battle.brief: Two waves, both old acquaintances. Then it's over.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Rain outside the cage drowns out footsteps

skills.name: String Lock
skills.description: Strings pin your feet and keep bleeding you

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: The crowd backs away; the ring gets smaller

skills.name: Throat Cut
skills.description: Massive execute chance on low-HP targets

h1-after.speaker: Narration
h1-after.text: When the last one fell, the rain stopped. She left the photograph at the edge of the cage: the Champion three years ago, surrounded by a crowd laughing too loudly.

h1-reward.title: Favour Repaid
h1-reward.description: She throws back a "don't keep me waiting next time" and walks into the rain.

h1-end.title: End of Segment 1
h1-end.text: The Champion rewraps his wrist. Half the streetlights are on. That's enough.

hero-volt-02.title: Segment 2 · Beneath the Cage
hero-volt-02.summary: The ledger lies open on the back-room table. That match three years ago was written before the bell.

h2-intro.speaker: Narration
h2-intro.text: After the cage emptied, the back-room lights were still on. An old ledger lay open on the table, its corners swollen from the rain.

h2-hero.speaker: Neon Champion
h2-hero.text: I thought I won that match three years ago. Now someone tells me that punch landed because they let it land.

h2-choice.prompt: The ledger is on its last page. Footsteps approach outside the door.

h2-ledger.speaker: Narration
h2-ledger.text: The last page reads: Champion wins, odds seven to one, payee — the fight promoter. Dated the night, three years ago.

h2-battle.title: Clearing the Back Room
h2-battle.brief: The boss isn't explaining. He brought people.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: The back-room lights go out one by one

skills.name: Shock Baton
skills.description: Close combo; the last hit stuns

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: Betting calls drift in from outside the cage

skills.name: Sound Suppression
skills.description: Sustained sound waves that slow and damage

h2-after.speaker: Narration
h2-after.text: The boss left through the back door with a "next week, another match". The Champion tucked the ledger away; its corners got worse.

h2-reward.title: Ledger in Hand
h2-reward.description: He didn't win that match three years ago. But tonight he drove these people out himself.

h2-end.title: End of Segment 2
h2-end.text: It started raining again. This time every light in the cage went out.

hero-volt-03.title: Segment 3 · The Last Match
hero-volt-03.summary: The boss turns the final bout into a city-wide broadcast. The opponent is the shadow the Champion left behind.

h3-intro.speaker: Narration
h3-intro.text: A week later the cage lit up again. The poster had one name: Neon Champion versus — Neon Champion.

h3-hero.speaker: Neon Champion
h3-hero.text: They found someone who fights exactly like me. Even the pause before a punch.

options: Step up and finish the match

h3-stage.speaker: Fight Promoter
h3-stage.text: "Simple rules," the boss said over the speaker. "Beat yourself and the debt is cleared."

h3-battle.title: The Last Match
h3-battle.brief: A shadow, some bodyguards, and the boss hiding behind them.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Every stand light comes on; nowhere to hide

skills.name: Ring Sweep
skills.description: A circular sweep that knocks targets back

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: The shadow copies every breath the Champion takes

skills.name: Neon Heavy Fist
skills.description: A charged punch that stuns on hit

h3-after.speaker: Narration
h3-after.text: When the shadow fell, the stands went frighteningly quiet. The boss slipped out the back; the ledger went into the brazier in the middle of the cage.

h3-reward.title: Debt Cleared
h3-reward.description: No winner, no loser. The cage never lit up again.

h3-end.title: End of Segment 3
h3-end.text: The Champion walked out. Every light on the street was on. For the first time it felt too bright.
